## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`cargo fmt --check`).
- [ ] I have verified that `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` produces zero warnings.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] Existing and new unit tests pass locally (`cargo test`).
- [ ] I have added the SPDX license header `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT` to any newly created files.
